questions.content: We know sleep is an activity we cannot do without, yet we let our hectic lifestyle wear us down until we cannot (21) ___ from bed. The longer we go without sleep, the more likely we are to have (22) ___ accident. Mid-day naps are catching (23) ___.
questions.explanation: The correct collocations are get from bed, have an accident, and catch on.
